# 1. Setup

## - Setting work directories

Defining work directory within rmarkdown chunk

```{r setup, include=TRUE}
local_wd_folder = dirname(dirname(dirname(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path)))
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = local_wd_folder)
```

```{r}
setwd(local_wd_folder)
```

Defining input data and output directories

```{r}
data_folder = paste0(local_wd_folder, '/Data/10x')
```

## - Setting seed

This step ensures reproducibility in randomized processes

```{r}
set.seed(seed = 123, kind = "Mersenne-Twister", normal.kind = "Inversion")
```

## - Options

```{r}
options(Seurat.object.assay.version = 'v3')
```

## - Loading libraries

```{r}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(Seurat)
library(scuttle)
library(scater)
library(dplyr)
library(R.utils)
library(harmony)
library(stringr)
library(SingleR)
library(scran)
library(gridExtra)
library(ggplot2)
```

## - Session Info

```{r}
writeLines(capture.output(sessionInfo()), file.path(dirname(rstudioapi::getSourceEditorContext()$path), '01_Session_Info.txt'))
```

# 2. INPUT: Importing pre-filtered samples

```{r}
Merged.SeuratObj <- readRDS(paste(data_folder, 'SC_Objects', 'QC_Processed.rds', sep = '/'))
```

# 3. RNA normalisation

```{r}
Merged.SeuratObj <- SCTransform(Merged.SeuratObj, verbose = FALSE)
Merged.SeuratObj <- FindVariableFeatures(Merged.SeuratObj, assay = 'SCT')
Merged.SeuratObj <- ScaleData(Merged.SeuratObj, assay = 'SCT')
```

# 4. Harmony Integration

```{r}
Merged.SeuratObj <- RunPCA(Merged.SeuratObj, verbose = FALSE, assay = 'SCT')

# These are now standard steps in the Seurat workflow for visualization and clustering
elbow_plot <- ElbowPlot(object = Merged.SeuratObj, ndims = 40)

print(elbow_plot)
```

```{r}
Merged.SeuratObj <- RunUMAP(Merged.SeuratObj, dims=1:15, reduction = 'pca', reduction.name = 'umap', reduction.key = 'umap', spread=1.5, min.dist=0.3, n.neighbors=50, metric="cosine", n.epochs = 200, negative.sample.rate = 5, return.model = T, seed.use = 123)
```

```{r}
Merged.SeuratObj <- RunHarmony(Merged.SeuratObj, 
                               group.by.vars = c('Identity'), 
                               dims.use = 1:15, max_iter = 50)
```

```{r}
Merged.SeuratObj <- RunUMAP(Merged.SeuratObj, dims=1:15, reduction = 'harmony', reduction.name = 'h_umap', reduction.key = 'h_umap', spread=1.5, min.dist=0.3, n.neighbors=50, metric="cosine", n.epochs = 200, negative.sample.rate = 5, return.model = T, seed.use = 123)
```

```{r}
# Integrated UMAP

plot1 <- DimPlot(Merged.SeuratObj, reduction = 'h_umap', group.by = 'Donor')
plot2 <- DimPlot(Merged.SeuratObj, reduction = 'h_umap', group.by = 'Identity', label = T)

plot1 + plot2

# Non-integrated UMAP for reference

plot1 <- DimPlot(Merged.SeuratObj, reduction = 'umap', group.by = 'Donor')
plot2 <- DimPlot(Merged.SeuratObj, reduction = 'umap', group.by = 'Identity', label = T)

plot1 + plot2
```

# 5. Saving integrated seurat object

```{r}
saveRDS(object = Merged.SeuratObj, file = paste(data_folder, 'SC_Objects', 'Integrated.rds', sep = '/'))
```
